# Auto-Generated Project Intelligence

> **Learned workspace conventions, gotchas, configuration patterns, and resolved problem fixes.**

---

## 📁 Repository Domains

This skill provides fast access to learned workspace observations in `auto/`:

| Domain | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `convention/` | All files | Workspace coding and architecture conventions |
| `gotcha/` | Workspace-wide | Tricky runtime gotchas and edge case traps |
| `problem-fix/` | Bugs & fixes | Past error-to-fix resolutions in this codebase |
| `javascript/` | `**/*.js`, `**/*.jsx` | JavaScript runtime idioms and component conventions |
| `css/` | `**/*.css` | Workspace style rules and layout behaviors |
| `config/` | Config files | JSON, YAML, TOML schema rules |
| `decision/` | Architecture | Key architectural decisions made in the project |

---

## 🔍 How to Use

When encountering unfamiliar project patterns, search the respective domain folder (e.g. `auto/gotcha/` or `auto/convention/`) to inspect verified patterns for this codebase.
